purpose: Preserve and reuse existing actual workpiece force/reference/view capabilities; identify the remaining physical definition and qualification gaps after M-VOLUME1 without duplicating functionality.

existing_capabilities.function: Native forward entry and saved response
existing_capabilities.implemented: evaluate_native already performs the existing native mean path, persists original accepted states and produces compact target/peak/endpoint/last response. The saved public reader associates the matching reference and views without NPZ or a new solve.

Original signed ON-body weak nodal force is minus the original assembled internal weak force on fixed workpiece DOFs. Original global total/material/regularization(Hu) components, opposite holding reaction, and disjoint fixed-DOF partitions are already computed and saved; thickness is already included in N.
existing_capabilities.limit: These are discrete generalized weak forces. They do not supply a continuous pressure density or allocate corner action to incident faces.

existing_capabilities.implemented: Public total lower-half [Fx,Fy], mirrored upper [Fx,-Fy], full mirrored net [2Fx,0] and two-sided normal magnitude 2*abs(Fy) already exist.
existing_capabilities.limit: The normal magnitude is an available report under the existing weak-force convention. It remains distinct from certified effective grip and from full-body net force; mirror reporting does not solve a second half.

existing_capabilities.function: Nodal loads, moments and complete saved ledger
existing_capabilities.implemented: The public observer already emits original total/material/Hu body-node vectors, group resultants and moments; physical/cut/intersection/interior groups keep each node once. M-LEDGER2 already reads all24 saved states and refines seven exclusive categories using original six force strings and original closure.

existing_capabilities.function: Actual deformation with three force components
existing_capabilities.implemented: The existing24-frame actual_states.gif already overlays original total/material/Hu force-vector panels on actual deformed mechanism/body geometry, with all body nodes and a common display scale. Geometry and Fy are reflected for the visual upper half.

actual_saved_manifest.mirroring: Visualization only about native symmetry; lower-body resultants stay half-model quantities; reflected arrows flip Fy, no doubled solved DOFs

existing_capabilities.limit: The display is an existing weak nodal force view, not pressure recovery. A new generic two-state three-component deformation overlay would duplicate it.

existing_capabilities.implemented: Actual deformed-region overlap/intersection and finite-face hit diagnostics already exist. Material-only owner P trace, original material support and M-VOLUME1 selected depth contractions add local observations.
existing_capabilities.limit: Node-window clearances and region diagnostics explicitly are not certified contact or penetration measures. Material P traces omit Hu and do not qualify total pressure.

existing_capabilities.implemented: M-REF2 already independently evaluates all24 original saved mechanical states at HP80/120 over all13440 elements and27378 real DOFs. Its original strict gates include signed total/material/Hu body force projections and disjoint holding projections.
existing_capabilities.directional_tangent_scope: The directional tangent check uses the actual five-node PORT direction, with fixed DOFs zero and deltaR=0. That tangent check is not a workpiece rigid-translation direction test; it does not negate the already checked full-force/body projection reference.
existing_capabilities.energy_scope: Independent analytic HP energy is archived without candidate energy comparison or energy qualification. An untested energy identity must not be presented as an existing gate, or presumed to be a required energy gradient identity for the current Hu weak residual.

actual_public_response_evidence.force_semantics: R is half-model actuator reaction; lower-body forces are signed weak-form resultants. Two-sided normal magnitude sum is not full-body net force. q_out is a weighted port displacement, not a surface gap.

target_workpiece.force_scope: Negative fixed-body weak-form holding reaction; material/Hu components, no pressure or threshold clipping
target_workpiece.clearance_scope: Source node-window bounds; raster geometry diagnostic, not surface distance or contact proof

matched_reference.qualification_scope: Accepted mechanical states of this exact h0.5 fixed-square cycle only. Original15 strict gates; no all-column, new separate Hu-error gate, stress-HP, pressure, effective-clamp, mesh/domain convergence or HF5 qualification
matched_reference.verification_scope: Matched saved JSON identities/all accepted states/2N bookkeeping and declared source bytes; no HP/NPZ archive re-audit

actual_public_response_evidence.original_reference_scope: All24 actual accepted/original saved states,13440 elements and27378 real DOFs; actual five-node PORT direction with deltaR=0; signed material/Hu body force and disjoint holding projections
actual_public_response_evidence.original_reference_qualification: Accepted mechanical states of this exact h0.5 fixed-square cycle only. Original15 strict gates; no all-column, new separate Hu-error gate, stress-HP, pressure, effective-clamp, mesh/domain convergence or HF5 qualification

reference_energy_scope_fields.analytic_HP_energy_scope: Archived independent reference only; no candidate energy comparison or qualification

remaining_physical_function_gap.nearest_actual_gap: A justified total interface-action/pressure interpretation including the original Hu weak term, with explicit boundary/corner meaning and physical contact/grip qualification. A total/material/Hu workpiece resultant API and its independent force reference already exist.
remaining_physical_function_gap.existing_reusable_primitives: Retain original response, original same-state body total/material/Hu vectors, holding partitions, mirror convention, existing independent force references and existing actual-state viewer. State their present discrete generalized-load meaning clearly while developing any stronger pressure or effective-grip claim.
remaining_physical_function_gap.Hu_boundary_dependency: The original Hu residual contracts higher displacement gradients with a state-dependent quadrature scale. Adding a scalar Hu contribution to P@N would not by itself define a total ordinary pressure. Recovering face/derivative/corner actions requires a consistent discrete boundary/virtual-work definition.
remaining_physical_function_gap.corner_dependency: Original nodal corner action and owner-specific material P samples do not uniquely determine pressure on each incident face; a recovery choice needs an explicit definition and validation.
remaining_physical_function_gap.qualification_dependency: Pressure/contact/effective grip and mesh/domain physical stability remain excluded from original mechanical reference qualification. Existing geometry diagnostics and one fixed-square h0.5 cycle cannot silently become those stronger claims.
remaining_physical_function_gap.coarse_route: First retain and document the already independently checked fixed-body total weak action as a discrete generalized load including Hu, then resolve the total boundary interpretation and choose the minimum physical qualification study required by the intended report. Reuse existing visible response/views; no automatic repeat of the24-state ledger, body-force HP reference or DD reconstruction.
remaining_physical_function_gap.virtual_work_or_energy_caution: A new rigid-body virtual-work interpretation, if selected, must address a specific unverified boundary meaning. Simple projection of already HP-checked full force is not a new missing force implementation. The PORT tangent scope and archived energy limitation alone do not establish a solver defect or justify a duplicate HP campaign.
remaining_physical_function_gap.planning_limit: Future route basis only. M-VOLUME1 closure is current work; no execution card, new calculation or authorization is created by this audit.

do_not_repeat: independent body-force projection already covered by the actual HP reference
audit_limit: Read-only source/saved-record audit; no existing capability is rerun or requalified, and no contact/pressure/clamp/HF5 flag is changed.
